about_trio_body: Trio was founded out of a love for the piano and the craftsmanship behind it. We believe that a fine instrument is much more than a piece of furniture or a product. It is a living thing, shaped by its materials, its environment, the way it is played and the passage of time. Each piano requires its own kind of attention, patience and precision.

Every piano that comes through Trio is restored, tuned and cared for by our own hands, with close attention to its tone, touch, mechanics and finish. The studio itself was built entirely by us, from the walls to the woodwork, with the same care and attention we bring to every instrument. Our goal was to create a place that feels as good to work in as it does to play and spend time in.

But Trio is more than a workshop. We wanted to create a place where craftsmanship and music naturally come together. Alongside our restoration work, we host piano concerts and cultural events that celebrate the piano and the music around it, giving people the opportunity to experience the instrument, the craft behind it and the people who dedicate their lives to it, all under one roof, in the heart of Jerusalem.
who_body: Trio was founded by three friends who met while studying at the Jerusalem Academy of Music and Dance.
All three of us are graduates of the Academy and former Outstanding Musicians in the IDF. Since then, each of us has continued to build a career around the piano from a different perspective.

Over the years we've worked as performers, teachers, piano technicians and craftsmen, continually expanding our knowledge of piano restoration, rebuilding and conservation. Our work combines musical understanding with meticulous craftsmanship, with the goal of bringing back the unique character, touch and sound of every piano.
Trio is where these three worlds naturally come together: craftsmanship, music and a lifelong friendship, all rooted in Jerusalem.

gadi.name: Gadi Milanez
gadi.bio: Gadi Milanez holds a Bachelor's degree in Piano Performance from the Jerusalem Academy of Music and Dance and served as an Outstanding Musician in the Israel Defense Forces. For more than 13 years, he has specialized in piano tuning, restoration and rebuilding, working alongside piano technicians in Israel and abroad. He has also completed professional training through the Randy Potter School of Piano Technology, Bösendorfer training programs, and courses with some of the world's leading piano tuners and restorers. Today, Gadi serves as the official piano technician of the Jerusalem Academy of Music and Dance.

nethanel.name: Nethanel Fastman
nethanel.bio: Netanel Fastman holds both Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Piano Performance from the Jerusalem Academy of Music and Dance and served as an Outstanding Musician in the Israel Defense Forces. For more than a decade, he has specialized in piano tuning, restoration and rebuilding in Israel and abroad. He received his professional training through hands-on work in the workshop of renowned piano technician and restorer Zamir Havkin. Today, Netanel serves as a piano technician for leading institutions, including the Israel Arts and Science Academy (IASA), the Brigham Young University Jerusalem Center, and the Jerusalem Academy High School for Music and Dance.

noam.name: Noam Shochat
noam.bio: Noam Shochat holds both Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Piano Performance from the Jerusalem Academy of Music and Dance and served as an Outstanding Musician in the Israel Defense Forces. Alongside his work as a pianist and teacher, he founded and managed cultural and hospitality businesses in Jerusalem, producing concerts, live performances and cultural events. He leads the connection between the workshop and its cultural life, combining his passion for the piano with his love for Jerusalem, the city where he grew as a musician.

rental.intro: Every piano leaves our workshop tuned, regulated and cleaned, and reaches you with professional transport and placement in the room you choose. We rent for single occasions — concerts, recordings, festivals, weddings and private events — and for longer periods at home, in a studio or in a classroom, including tuning after delivery and care throughout the rental. Tell us what you need and for how long, and we'll match you with the right instrument and a price that suits the occasion.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Trio Piano Studio sees accessibility as part of the service it offers, and works to make this website usable by as many people as possible, including people with disabilities.
accessibility.compliance: This site aims to comply with Israeli Standard IS 5568, which adopts the international WCAG 2.0 guidelines at level AA, as required by the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 2013.
accessibility.measures: Semantic HTML structure with headings and landmarks; full keyboard navigation with a visible focus indicator; a skip-to-content link; text alternatives for images; colour contrast checked against the AA thresholds; support for text enlargement up to 160%; and an accessibility menu offering text size, high contrast, inverted and grayscale colour, link highlighting, a readable font, reduced motion and a large cursor.
accessibility.tested: The site has been tested with current versions of Chrome, Safari, Edge and Firefox, on desktop and mobile, with keyboard navigation.
accessibility.limits: Despite our efforts, some parts of the site may not yet be fully accessible. We continue to improve them, and would be glad to hear from you.
accessibility.contact: If you encounter an accessibility problem, or need an accommodation in order to use the site, please contact our accessibility coordinator. We will respond as quickly as we can.
